title: 축산자조금의 조성 및 운용에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:13:0:00013:part:1/1
title_original: 축산자조금의 조성 및 운용에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 13 (Costs associated with the use of the mandatory fund) According to Article 21(7) of the Act, the costs associated with the use of the mandatory fund shall not exceed the following criteria, depending on the amount of the mandatory fund:
1. If the amount of the mandatory fund is 100 million won or more: 80% of the amount of the mandatory fund.
2. If the amount of the mandatory fund is less than 100 million won: 10% of the amount of the mandatory fund.
